entries.source: Connect to Globulation 2 games on your local network.
entries.google_draft: तुमच्या स्थानिक नेटवर्कवर Globulation 2 गेम्सशी कनेक्ट करा.
entries.proposed_final: तुमच्या स्थानिक नेटवर्कवरील Globulation 2 खेळांशी जोडणी करण्यासाठी.
entries.rationale: Permission explanation for joining LAN games; use a purpose phrase rather than a command to the player. जोडणी preserves connecting and networkवरील correctly locates the games.

entries.source: Globulation 2 discovers and joins multiplayer games hosted on your local network.
entries.google_draft: Globulation 2 तुमच्या स्थानिक नेटवर्कवर होस्ट केलेले मल्टीप्लेअर गेम्स शोधतो आणि त्यात सामील होतो.
entries.proposed_final: Globulation 2 मध्ये तुमच्या स्थानिक नेटवर्कवर आयोजित केलेले अनेक खेळाडूंचे सामने शोधून त्यांत सामील होता येते.
entries.rationale: Preserve both discovering and joining locally hosted multiplayer games. अनेक खेळाडूंचे सामने expresses multiplayer without a raw English loan; a neutral capability phrase avoids assigning an arbitrary grammatical gender to the product name.

consulted_apple_sources.passage: Steps2–3, lines20–27: matching lproj support, then the declared development region if no supported user language matches.
consulted_apple_sources.interpretation: Package en.lproj and mr.lproj with development region en so unsupported preferences retain English fallback.
Localized human-readable values belong in InfoPlist.strings inside the matching language project; base Info.plist is fallback.
